title: 도치 - Only after + 도치
explanation: 'Only after'가 문두에 오면 주절에 도치가 일어난다. 'did the company realize'가 올바른 도치 형태이다.
correctExample: Only after conducting a thorough investigation did the company realize the full extent of the damage caused by the security breach.
incorrectExample: Only after conducting a thorough investigation the company realized the full extent of the damage caused by the security breach.
tip: Only after/when/if + 부사절 → 주절 도치(조동사 + S + V)
distractors: the company realized,the company did realize,has the company realizing

title: 어휘 - exacerbate vs aggravate
explanation: exacerbate는 '(상황/문제를) 악화시키다'의 격식 어휘이다. aggravate(악화시키다, 구어), elaborate(상세히 설명하다), accelerate(가속하다)는 격식 문맥의 악화 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The prolonged supply chain disruptions are expected to exacerbate the existing shortage of semiconductor components in the industry.
incorrectExample: The prolonged supply chain disruptions are expected to elaborate the existing shortage of semiconductor components in the industry.
tip: 상황 악화(격식) → exacerbate / 악화(일반) → aggravate / 설명 → elaborate

title: 가정법 - It is essential that + 원형
explanation: 'It is essential that' 구문에서는 동사원형 'submit'을 사용한다. submits(3인칭 단수), submitted(과거), will submit(미래)는 이 가정법 구문에 부적절하다.
correctExample: It is essential that every department head submit a comprehensive quarterly performance report to the executive committee by Friday.
incorrectExample: It is essential that every department head submits a comprehensive quarterly performance report to the executive committee by Friday.
tip: It is essential/important/necessary + that + S + V(원형)

title: 연어 - yield results
explanation: '결과를 산출하다'라는 고급 연어 'yield results'가 필요하다. give(주다), produce(생산하다), bring(가져오다)는 results와 격식적 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The newly implemented marketing strategy is expected to yield significant results within the first two quarters of its deployment.
incorrectExample: The newly implemented marketing strategy is expected to give significant results within the first two quarters of its deployment.
tip: 결과 산출 → yield results / 이익 산출 → yield returns/profits

title: 시제 - 미래완료 진행형
explanation: 'by next month'라는 미래 기한까지 계속 진행될 동작을 나타내므로 미래완료 진행형 'will have been operating'을 사용한다.
correctExample: By next month, the company will have been operating its overseas branch in Singapore for a full decade since its establishment.
incorrectExample: By next month, the company has been operating its overseas branch in Singapore for a full decade since its establishment.
tip: by + 미래시점 + for + 기간 → will have been + V-ing
distractors: has been operating,was operating,had been operating

title: 어휘 - curtail vs reduce
explanation: curtail은 '(비용/활동을) 축소하다/삭감하다'의 격식 어휘이다. reduce(줄이다, 일반적), constrain(제약하다), restrict(제한하다)는 축소/삭감의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: Due to the economic downturn, the company was forced to curtail its research and development expenditures for the upcoming year.
incorrectExample: Due to the economic downturn, the company was forced to constrain its research and development expenditures for the upcoming year.
tip: 비용 축소(격식) → curtail / 줄이다(일반) → reduce / 제약 → constrain

title: 접속사 - inasmuch as (~이므로, 격식)
explanation: '~이므로'라는 이유의 격식체 접속사 'inasmuch as'가 필요하다. because(이유, 일반), due to(전치사), since(이유/시간)는 격식 법적 문맥에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The contract shall be deemed valid inasmuch as both parties have fulfilled all obligations stipulated in the original agreement.
incorrectExample: The contract shall be deemed valid due to both parties have fulfilled all obligations stipulated in the original agreement.
tip: 격식 이유(~이므로) → inasmuch as / insofar as

title: 어휘 - promulgate vs announce
explanation: promulgate는 '(법률/규정을) 공포하다'의 격식 법률 어휘이다. announce(발표하다, 일반), promote(촉진하다), proclaim(선언하다)는 법률 공포의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The regulatory agency will promulgate new environmental standards that all manufacturing companies must adhere to by January next year.
incorrectExample: The regulatory agency will promote new environmental standards that all manufacturing companies must adhere to by January next year.
tip: 법률/규정 공포 → promulgate / 발표(일반) → announce / 촉진 → promote

title: 가정법 - wish + 과거완료 (과거 후회)
explanation: 과거에 대한 후회를 나타내므로 'wish + had p.p.' 구조를 사용한다. allocated(과거), has allocated(현재완료), would allocate(조건)는 과거 후회의 wish 구문에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The finance director wishes the company had allocated more funds to employee training programs during the previous fiscal year.
incorrectExample: The finance director wishes the company allocated more funds to employee training programs during the previous fiscal year.
tip: 과거 후회 → wish + S + had p.p. / 현재 소망 → wish + S + V-ed

title: 연어 - draw a distinction
explanation: '구별을 짓다'라는 고급 연어 'draw a distinction'이 필요하다. make(만들다), find(찾다), set(설정하다)는 distinction과 격식적 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The legal counsel drew a clear distinction between the two clauses in the contract to avoid any potential misinterpretation later.
incorrectExample: The legal counsel made a clear distinction between the two clauses in the contract to avoid any potential misinterpretation later.
tip: 구별 짓다 → draw a distinction / 결론 도출 → draw a conclusion

title: 어휘 - obviate vs eliminate
explanation: obviate는 '(필요/문제를) 없애다/불필요하게 만들다'의 격식 어휘이다. eliminate(제거하다), obstruct(방해하다), obligate(의무화하다)는 불필요하게 만드는 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The new automated system will obviate the need for manual data entry, thereby reducing human error and improving overall accuracy.
incorrectExample: The new automated system will obstruct the need for manual data entry, thereby reducing human error and improving overall accuracy.
tip: 필요를 없애다 → obviate the need for / 제거 → eliminate / 방해 → obstruct

title: 도치 - No sooner ~ than
explanation: 'No sooner'가 문두에 오면 도치가 일어나고 'than'과 함께 쓰인다. 'had the announcement been made than'이 올바르다.
correctExample: No sooner had the announcement been made than investors began selling shares in anticipation of a decline in stock prices.
incorrectExample: No sooner the announcement had been made than investors began selling shares in anticipation of a decline in stock prices.
tip: No sooner + had + S + p.p. + than + S + V(과거)
distractors: the announcement had been made,was the announcement made,the announcement was made

title: 어휘 - delineate vs describe
explanation: delineate는 '(경계/범위를) 명확히 기술하다'의 격식 어휘이다. describe(묘사하다, 일반), designate(지정하다), deliberate(숙고하다)는 명확 기술의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The contract clearly delineates the responsibilities of each party involved in the joint venture to prevent any future disputes.
incorrectExample: The contract clearly deliberates the responsibilities of each party involved in the joint venture to prevent any future disputes.
tip: 명확 기술/규정 → delineate / 일반 묘사 → describe / 지정 → designate

title: 가정법 - but for (= If it were not for)
explanation: '~이 아니었더라면'의 의미로 'But for'는 가정법을 이끈다. Without(~없이, 전치사), Except for(~을 제외하고), Apart from(~외에)는 가정법의 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: But for the generous financial support from the investors, the startup would not have survived the initial years of operation.
incorrectExample: Except for the generous financial support from the investors, the startup would not have survived the initial years of operation.
tip: ~이 아니었더라면 → But for = If it were not for / If it had not been for

title: 연어 - take precedence over
explanation: '~보다 우선하다'라는 고급 연어 'take precedence over'가 필요하다. have(가지다), hold(잡다), gain(얻다)는 precedence와 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: Workplace safety regulations always take precedence over production targets regardless of the urgency of the manufacturing schedule.
incorrectExample: Workplace safety regulations always have precedence over production targets regardless of the urgency of the manufacturing schedule.
tip: ~보다 우선 → take precedence over
distractors: have precedence over,hold precedence over,gain precedence over

title: 어휘 - amenable vs agreeable
explanation: amenable은 '(제안/변화에) 기꺼이 응하는/수용적인'의 격식 어휘이다. agreeable(동의하는, 일반), accessible(접근 가능한), accountable(책임이 있는)는 수용적의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The union representatives indicated that they would be amenable to further negotiations regarding the revised compensation package.
incorrectExample: The union representatives indicated that they would be accessible to further negotiations regarding the revised compensation package.
tip: 수용적인/기꺼이 응하는 → amenable to / 동의하는 → agreeable to

title: 시제 - 과거완료 vs 과거 (시간 순서)
explanation: 두 과거 사건 중 먼저 일어난 사건에 과거완료 'had already left'를 사용한다. already left(과거), has already left(현재완료), would already leave(조건)는 두 과거 사건의 시간 순서를 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: By the time the senior vice president arrived at the meeting, most of the board members had already left the conference room.
incorrectExample: By the time the senior vice president arrived at the meeting, most of the board members already left the conference room.
tip: By the time + 과거 → 주절은 had + p.p.(더 앞선 과거)
distractors: already left,has already left,would already leave

title: 어휘 - relinquish vs abandon
explanation: relinquish는 '(권리/지위를) 포기하다'의 격식 어휘이다. abandon(버리다, 일반), renounce(공식 포기), surrender(항복/굴복)는 권리 포기의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The outgoing CEO agreed to relinquish control of the company's daily operations to the newly appointed management leadership team.
incorrectExample: The outgoing CEO agreed to surrender control of the company's daily operations to the newly appointed management leadership team.
tip: 권리/지위 포기(격식) → relinquish / 버리다 → abandon / 공식 포기 → renounce

title: 가정법 - It is imperative that + 원형
explanation: 'It is imperative that' 구문에서는 동사원형 'be'를 사용한다. is(현재), was(과거), would be(조건)는 이 가정법 구문에 부적절하다.
correctExample: It is imperative that all confidential financial documents be stored in a secure location accessible only to authorized personnel.
incorrectExample: It is imperative that all confidential financial documents are stored in a secure location accessible only to authorized personnel.
tip: It is imperative/vital/crucial + that + S + V(원형)

title: 연어 - levy a fine
explanation: '벌금을 부과하다'라는 고급 연어 'levy a fine'이 필요하다. impose(부과하다, 유사), charge(청구하다), apply(적용하다)는 fine과 격식 법적 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The regulatory authority decided to levy a substantial fine on the corporation for failing to comply with environmental protection laws.
incorrectExample: The regulatory authority decided to apply a substantial fine on the corporation for failing to comply with environmental protection laws.
tip: 벌금 부과 → levy a fine / 세금 부과 → levy a tax

title: 어휘 - perpetuate vs continue
explanation: perpetuate는 '(상황/관행을) 영속시키다'의 격식 어휘이다. continue(계속하다, 일반), persist(지속하다), persevere(인내하다)는 영속화의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The company's outdated hiring practices may perpetuate the lack of diversity within the executive leadership team going forward.
incorrectExample: The company's outdated hiring practices may persevere the lack of diversity within the executive leadership team going forward.
tip: 영속시키다 → perpetuate / 계속하다 → continue / 인내하다 → persevere

title: 도치 - Hardly ~ when
explanation: 'Hardly'가 문두에 오면 도치가 일어나고 'when'과 함께 쓰인다. 'had the negotiations begun when'이 올바르다.
correctExample: Hardly had the negotiations begun when a fundamental disagreement arose over the terms of the proposed intellectual property clause.
incorrectExample: Hardly the negotiations had begun when a fundamental disagreement arose over the terms of the proposed intellectual property clause.
tip: Hardly + had + S + p.p. + when + S + V(과거)
distractors: the negotiations had begun,did the negotiations begin,the negotiations began

title: 어휘 - amalgamate vs merge
explanation: amalgamate는 '(기관/기업을) 합병하다/통합하다'의 격식 어휘이다. merge(합병하다, 일반), combine(결합하다), consolidate(통합하다)는 합병의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The board of directors voted to amalgamate the two subsidiary companies into a single entity to achieve greater operational efficiency.
incorrectExample: The board of directors voted to consolidate the two subsidiary companies into a single entity to achieve greater operational efficiency.
tip: 기업 합병(격식) → amalgamate / 합병(일반) → merge / 통합 → consolidate

title: 가정법 - as if + 과거 (현재 사실 반대)
explanation: 'as if + 과거 동사'는 현재 사실과 반대되는 상황을 나타낸다. 'as if it were'가 올바르다. as if it is(직설법), as if it was(비격식), like it is(구어)는 격식 가정법에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The CEO spoke about the expansion plan as if it were already approved by the board, even though the vote had not yet taken place.
incorrectExample: The CEO spoke about the expansion plan as if it is already approved by the board, even though the vote had not yet taken place.
tip: as if/as though + S + V-ed/were (현재 사실 반대)
distractors: as if it is,as if it was,like it is

title: 연어 - bear the brunt of
explanation: '~의 가장 큰 타격을 받다'라는 고급 연어 'bear the brunt of'가 필요하다. take(취하다), suffer(겪다), carry(나르다)는 brunt과 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The manufacturing division is expected to bear the brunt of the cost-cutting measures announced by the chief financial officer.
incorrectExample: The manufacturing division is expected to suffer the brunt of the cost-cutting measures announced by the chief financial officer.
tip: 가장 큰 타격을 받다 → bear the brunt of
distractors: suffer the brunt of,take the brunt of,carry the brunt of

title: 어휘 - remuneration vs salary
explanation: remuneration은 '(노동에 대한) 보수/보상'의 격식 어휘이다. salary(급여, 일반), revenue(수익), reimbursement(경비 환급)는 노동 보수의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The total remuneration package for the executive position includes base salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive stock options.
incorrectExample: The total reimbursement package for the executive position includes base salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive stock options.
tip: 보수(격식) → remuneration / 급여(일반) → salary / 경비 환급 → reimbursement

title: 접속사 - lest (= so that ~ not, 격식)
explanation: '~하지 않도록'이라는 부정 목적의 격식체 접속사 'lest'가 필요하다. lest 뒤에는 동사원형 또는 should + V가 온다.
correctExample: The compliance officer reviewed the regulations thoroughly lest the company inadvertently violate any of the newly enacted trade laws.
incorrectExample: The compliance officer reviewed the regulations thoroughly so that the company inadvertently violate any of the newly enacted trade laws.
tip: ~하지 않도록(격식) → lest + S + (should) + V(원형)

title: 어휘 - predicated on vs based on
explanation: predicated on은 '~에 근거하여/~을 전제로'의 격식 어휘이다. based on(~에 근거하여, 일반), predicted on(예측된), preceded by(~에 의해 선행된)는 격식 전제의 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The entire business strategy is predicated on the assumption that consumer demand will continue to grow at its current rate.
incorrectExample: The entire business strategy is predicted on the assumption that consumer demand will continue to grow at its current rate.
tip: ~을 전제로(격식) → predicated on / ~에 근거(일반) → based on

title: 가정법 - 제안동사 propose + that + 원형
explanation: 제안동사 'proposed' 뒤의 that절에서는 동사원형 'allocate'를 사용한다. allocates(3인칭), allocated(과거), would allocate(조건)는 제안동사 뒤에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The finance committee proposed that the company allocate additional funds toward employee professional development programs next year.
incorrectExample: The finance committee proposed that the company allocates additional funds toward employee professional development programs next year.
tip: propose/suggest/recommend + that + S + V(원형)

title: 연어 - wield influence
explanation: '영향력을 행사하다'라는 고급 연어 'wield influence'가 필요하다. use(사용하다), carry(나르다), hold(잡다)는 influence와 격식적 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The chairman of the board continues to wield considerable influence over the company's strategic decision-making processes and outcomes.
incorrectExample: The chairman of the board continues to use considerable influence over the company's strategic decision-making processes and outcomes.
tip: 영향력 행사 → wield influence / 권력 행사 → wield power

title: 어휘 - tantamount to vs equivalent to
explanation: tantamount to는 '~나 다름없는/~에 해당하는'의 격식 어휘이다. equivalent to(동등한, 일반), analogous to(유사한), paramount to(최고의, 의미 다름)는 '다름없는'의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: Failure to disclose the conflict of interest is tantamount to a violation of the company's corporate ethics and governance policies.
incorrectExample: Failure to disclose the conflict of interest is paramount to a violation of the company's corporate ethics and governance policies.
tip: ~나 다름없는 → tantamount to / 동등한 → equivalent to / 유사한 → analogous to

title: 도치 - Under no circumstances
explanation: 'Under no circumstances'가 문두에 오면 도치가 일어난다. 'should employees share'가 올바른 도치 형태이다.
correctExample: Under no circumstances should employees share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals regardless of the stated reason.
incorrectExample: Under no circumstances employees should share their login credentials with unauthorized individuals regardless of the stated reason.
tip: Under no circumstances/In no way + 조동사 + S + V → 도치
distractors: employees should share,employees share,do employees sharing

title: 어휘 - adjudicate vs judge
explanation: adjudicate는 '(분쟁을) 재정하다/판결하다'의 격식 법률 어휘이다. judge(판단하다, 일반), arbitrate(중재하다), mediate(조정하다)는 재정/판결의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: An independent panel was appointed to adjudicate the dispute between the two companies regarding the patent infringement allegations.
incorrectExample: An independent panel was appointed to mediate the dispute between the two companies regarding the patent infringement allegations.
tip: 재정/판결(격식) → adjudicate / 중재 → arbitrate / 조정 → mediate

title: 가정법 - It is time + 과거동사
explanation: 'It is time' 구문 뒤에는 가정법 과거 동사를 사용한다. 'updated'(과거형)가 올바르다. updates(현재), will update(미래), has updated(현재완료)는 이 구문에 부적절하다.
correctExample: It is time the company updated its outdated information technology infrastructure to remain competitive in the rapidly evolving market.
incorrectExample: It is time the company updates its outdated information technology infrastructure to remain competitive in the rapidly evolving market.
tip: It is (high/about) time + S + V-ed(가정법 과거)
